content_sections.heading: OUAT Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. 05/CCRH/Biochem gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download OUAT notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Post Graduate degree (M.Sc) in Basic/Life Science preferably in Biochemistry/Biotechnology/Zoology/Microbiology/Bioinformatics with minimum 55% marks; Master in Veterinary Science (M.V.Sc) with specialization in Animal Biochemistry/Animal Biotechnology/Veterinary Microbiology/Animal Physiology Age limit: Maximum 35 years (as on the date of interview) Other conditions: No TA/DA will be provided for attending the interview. Desirable: NET/GATE/CSIR-UGC qualified candidates will be given preference Knowledge of basic molecular and analytical techniques, cell culture, gene and protein expression, and cancer biology Knowledge of basic computer operation

content_sections.heading: OUAT Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Job Description
content_sections.text: Laboratory work Field visit Project related office assistance

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Three years or up to completion of project, whichever is earlier. Initially for 06 months, likely to be extended subject to satisfactory performance and/or co-terminus with project tenure. Engagement is contractual, purely temporary and co-terminus with the project. No claim for any form of regular appointment under OUAT or Government. Engagement may be terminated at any time without notice or assigning any reason. Candidates may leave by giving one-month notice to the PI.

content_sections.heading: How Will OUAT Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Verification of documents Walk-in interview Candidates report by 2 PM for verification of documents before the interview at 02.30 PM.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Application in the Annexure-I format, duly signed All original certificates and mark sheets from matriculation to post-graduation A set of attested photocopies of each certificate and mark sheet, and age proof Two recent passport size photographs Updated bio-data Experience certificates, and a no objection certificate from the present employer, if any

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for OUAT Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill in the application in the Annexure-I format and sign it. Report at the venue on 26-11-2026 by 2 PM for verification of documents. Submit the application at the time of interview with self-attested testimonials, age proof and a passport size photograph. Bring all original certificates and experience certificates; without them the candidate will not be allowed to appear. Attend the walk-in interview at 02.30 PM in the Conference Hall of the college.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Any change to the schedule will be notified on the OUAT website, www.ouat.ac.in. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview. Concealing facts or canvassing in any form leads to disqualification or termination even after appointment. Failure to maintain discipline or official protocol, or to perform assigned duties, makes the candidate liable to termination.
